scope: Full multi-vector review of /var/lib/dsh/Project/speech-front (all src/*.rs, src/pronounce/*.rs, lexicon.toml) and its /var/lib/dsh/teratts-server integration modules (src/speechfront.rs, src/russian_only.rs, src/lexicon_reload.rs).
approval_ref: user:turn-3:ask_user_question:Portable sequential-review/v2 campaign + Gemini/Opus pool + Both repos & mechanical checks

checks.limits: Zero clippy warnings across all targets in speech-front.

checks.procedure: diff -u speech-front/lexicon.toml teratts-server/src/lexicon.toml && diff -u speech-front/src/normalize.rs teratts-server/src/speechfront.rs
checks.limits: lexicon.toml is byte-identical (186 entries); normalize.rs vs speechfront.rs has 646 diff lines.

checks.procedure: Cross-project ignored integration tests (cross_project_approve_reloads, installed_converter_cross_project) + live CLI reproductions
checks.environment: linux-worker (Debian x86_64, compiled speech-front + prepared cmudict.db)
checks.limits: Both cross-project tests passed; 8 CLI normalization/conversion defects reproduced verbatim.

limitations: Native dsh-review preset tools are not active in this session; executed as a user-approved portable sequential-review/v2 campaign via workflow.
Reviewer pool used Gemini (ninitux/gemini-flash-high-latest) and Opus (ninitux/claude-opus-latest); Opus judge runs in an isolated fresh context (context_only independence, not cross_model).
Token/billing usage counters from the upstream gateway are not exposed to the workflow runtime and are recorded as unknown.
No live Tailscale review-server browser session or remote Git push was executed; review.rs HTTP/CSRF/Git checks were verified via unit tests and static source inspection.
checkpoint: Completed all 6 reviewer lanes (G1-G3, O1-O3), 5 mechanical check suites, candidate reconciliation (57 candidates), and independent Opus judge evaluation (lane-judge). No remaining review lanes.

limitations: No HTTP load/concurrency testing was performed against speech-front serve or the Axum review server; concurrency findings (O1-01, O3-01, O3-02) are source-proven only.
No fuzz testing of normalization inputs — edge cases beyond the 8 reproduced CLI scenarios may exist in Unicode boundary handling, extreme-length numbers, or nested lexicon matches.
The review used two model families (Gemini Flash, Claude Opus); cross-model independence is context-level, not model-level — both families share training-data overlap that could create blind spots.
Token/billing counters were unavailable; reviewer effort distribution across lanes cannot be verified quantitatively.

No runtime profiling was performed to validate the performance findings (G1-07 longest_match allocation, G2-05 per-request subprocess spawn, G3-14 N+1 SQLite queries) — these are source-proven but unquantified.

The speech-front review server's CSRF protection, session handling, and Git publisher race conditions (O3-03, O3-07) were verified through unit tests and source inspection only — no live penetration testing.

Licensing constraint between speech-front (proprietary) and teratts-server (GPL-3.0) was noted but not legally evaluated; its impact on the remediation path for G3-07 is architectural, not assessed here.
acceptance_conditions: Backport the three reproduced HIGH fixes (G1-01, G1-02, G1-06) to speech-front/src/normalize.rs and verify each with a new unit test that asserts the correct output.

Fix teratts-server/src/russian_only.rs normalize_symbols (G2-02) to pass 0x00C0..=0x024F, 0x1E00..=0x1EFF, 0xFB00..=0xFB06, and 0xFF21..=0xFF5A through to speech-front instead of replacing them with spaces; add a unit test for café, ﬂow, and ＡＰＩ.

Establish a mechanical drift guard for G3-07: either extract shared normalization into a common crate consumed by both projects, or add a CI check that fails when normalize.rs and speechfront.rs diverge beyond an approved allowlist.
Fix the года duplication bug (G1-11) in both copies: parse_numeric_date and parse_iso_date must consume trailing года/год/г. tokens to prevent года года output.

Address the MEDIUM concurrency cluster before multi-user deployment: set busy_timeout >= 5000 ms in Store::open (O3-01), gate Store::initialize() migration behind a version check to avoid write transactions on read-only paths (O3-02), and replace the synchronous Mutex in review.rs::decision with a Tokio-aware lock or spawn_blocking (O1-01).

Re-run the full check suite (checks 1-5) at the remediated snapshot and confirm all existing tests pass, new regression tests for G1-01, G1-02, G1-06, G1-11, G2-02 pass, and the 8 CLI reproductions from check-5 produce correct output.
